content.en: The **External Sector** encompasses all economic transactions between residents of India and the rest of the world. Recent developments focus on **Trade Liberalization**, **Capital Account Convertibility**, and the diversification of **Foreign Exchange Reserves**. These factors directly impact the **Balance of Payments (BoP)** and the stability of the **Indian Rupee**.
